offers_products.reason: Sells investment management and advisory; the funds are vehicles for fee-based asset management, not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Private markets asset management: fund-of-funds, secondaries, venture debt, direct lending and advisory/research services for investors.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clients are LPs, family offices and wealth managers, not individual households directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Investors in its funds include institutional LPs, family offices and wealth managers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Management and advisory fees on committed capital across long-life funds recur year after year.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fees mostly based on committed capital, unaffected by market moves, though new fundraising can slow in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Fund commitments by investors are large, infrequent allocations rather than small repeat purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Clients pay for investment professionals' selection skill, relationships and judgment across fund strategies, supported by data tools.

large_customers.reason: Main investors are institutional LPs, family offices and wealth managers allocating to private market funds.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset manager earning fees; needs no plants, fleets or networks to grow.

notes: Appears to be the renamed P10; client mix (institutional vs. wealth-channel individuals) is not detailed on the site.
